admissibility_transition_hypothesis.description: Theorem hypotheses derived from formalized topology transitions.

hypotheses.statement: Theorem remains valid under boundary_deformation (ATT-001) if the topology of the admissibility manifold is preserved.
Asymptotic results hold unless the system crosses a basin_to_chaos_transition (RST-002) boundary.
Composition legality is invariant under orientation_window_rotation (OWT-001) transitions.
